name: Enterpret
description: Ask questions about your customer feedback and pull verbatim quotes with citations.

methods.whenToUse: Recommended. Use an organization auth token from Settings → Enterpret MCP. This is the primary, store-ready connection method.
methods.guidanceMd: Generate an auth token in Enterpret under Settings, Enterpret MCP, then paste it below. One token belongs to one Enterpret organization. This is the recommended connection method.
methods.label: Use an auth token

credentialFields.label: Enterpret auth token
credentialFields.placeholder: Paste the token from Settings, Enterpret MCP
credentialFields.helperMd: An organization auth token can read that organization's customer feedback. Use a token from Settings > Enterpret MCP; it expires after six months.

warnings: Enterpret auth tokens expire six months after you generate them. Generate a replacement before the current one lapses.
This connection reads customer feedback, including verbatim quotes with speaker attribution.
run_graph_query starts as Ask first. Cypher is not established as read-only even when Enterpret advertises readOnlyHint.

methods.whenToUse: Draft until Enterpret fixes OAuth scopes. Prefer an organization auth token. Use browser sign-in only when each person must run under their own Enterpret account.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to Enterpret in the browser. Each person connects with their own Enterpret account, and Enterpret attributes their queries individually. Prefer an organization auth token until Enterpret honors mcp:read without granting mcp:write.
methods.label: Sign in with Enterpret (draft)
warnings: Draft: Enterpret currently grants mcp:write when Paperclip requests mcp:read. Prefer an organization auth token until Enterpret fixes this scope over-grant.
You need an Enterpret account with access to your organization's feedback.
This connection reads customer feedback, including verbatim quotes with speaker attribution.
